findings.finding: Inspected publisher Double Bass 1 notation, opening Baile Rustico: treble-clef upper-register melody, alternating 6/8 and 3/4 every bar, ties across accents, changing bowing and pizzicato. Estimate level 6 for the upper-register first part, no extra ensemble uplift. Only first-movement opening sampled; later four miniatures and other parts unseen.
Complete publisher context confirms five movements with mixed meters including 7/8, quartal Scherzo harmony and lyrical contrasting movements.

Confidence reassessed independently as medium: actual work-specific notation plus full-work publisher technical context constrain a defensible broad band; no numeric grade change and no claim of exhaustive coverage.

findings.finding: Inspected complete-edition score at PDF pp1,4,9,14,19,23,26, covering all three preludes and finale. First cello repeatedly leads in tenor/treble registers with fast chromatic shifts, articulated sixteenths, triplet figures, large melodic intervals and a final portamento; supporting cellos have double stops, syncopated chords and independent bass figures. Hardest first-part estimate level6 plus one for coordinated offbeat jazz articulation, melody/accompaniment balance and flexible transitions gives level7. Whole three-prelude set; moderate blues middle movement within lively outer movements, mixed major/minor prevents one reliable mode.
